parameters.name: AppSource
parameters.description:
The SAE application type. Valid values:

*   **micro_service**
*   **web**
*   **job**

parameters.name: CpuStrategy
parameters.description:
The CPU allocation policy. Valid values:

*   **request**: CPU cores are allocated only when a request is initiated.
*   **always**: Fixed CPU cores are always allocated.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The number of entries to return. Valid values: 0 to 100.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sae get-warning-event-metric --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 1675823135951 --end-time 1675824035951 --limit 10 --app-source micro_service --cpu-strategy always --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sae GET /pop/v1/sam/getWarningEventMetric --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime 1675824035951 --CpuStrategy always --StartTime 1675823135951 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Limit 10 --AppSource micro_service --header "Content-Type=application/json"
